attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-worker as a hardened systemd service on node1: runs as dedicated unprivileged system user inventory-worker, loops writing a counter and log line every 10s, confined to /var/lib/inventory via ProtectSystem=strict + ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory + ProtectHome, with NoNewPrivileges=yes and a broad set of additional systemd sandboxing directives (PrivateTmp, PrivateDevices, RestrictNamespaces, MemoryDenyWriteExecute, CapabilityBoundingSet=, etc). Verified confinement by falsification (same-profile write to /var/lib/inventory succeeds; writes to /root and /etc fail). Completed mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-reboot boot_id and service/data state, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service re-enabled/re-started automatically with data (count, log) intact and continuing to grow.
